items.title: Revisiting somatosensory evoked potentials in motor neuron diseases: neurophysiological insights from a large cohort.
items.summary: To systematically investigate Somatosensory Evoked Potential (SEP) abnormalities in a large cohort of patients with Motor Neuron Disease (MND), and to explore their relationship with Motor Evoked Potentials (MEPs) and clinical phenotypes. We retrospectively analyzed 267 patients with confirmed MND who underwent standardized SEPs and transcranial magnetic stimulation. Patients were divided into pure/predominant Upper Motor Neuron (UMN) and pure/predominant Lower Motor Neuron/Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (LMN/ALS) groups. SEP abnormalities were assessed using internal normative data, including prolonged latencies, reduced amplitudes, and increased N20-P25 amplitudes. MEPs were classified semi-quantitatively as normal or abnormal by independent raters. At least one SEP abnormality was detected in 75 % of patients, with no significant differences between the UMN and LMN/ALS groups. Increased N20-P25 amplitudes were observed in both phenotypes, suggesting widespread sensory cortical hyperexcitability across the MND spectrum. In contrast, abnormal MEPs were significantly more frequent in UMN patients (p < 0.001). No significant association was found between SEP abnormalities and MEP findings. Upper- and lower-limb SEP latencies were strongly correlated (all p < 0.001), whereas increased SEP amplitudes did not correlate with latency abnormalities. SEP abnormalities are highly prevalent in MND and appear largely independent from corticospinal dysfunction. Increased SEP amplitudes likely reflect primary cortical sensory hyperexcitability rather than impaired sensory conduction. These findings support the concept of MND as a multisystem network disorder that involves sensory cortical circuits and highlight the role of SEPs in the diagnostic workup.
items.titleZh: 重新审视运动神经元病中的体感诱发电位：来自大型队列的神经生理学见解
items.summaryZh: 这项针对267名运动神经元病患者的大型回顾性研究发现，75%的患者存在体感诱发电位异常，且在上运动神经元为主和ALS/下运动神经元为主两组中发生率相似。特别值得注意的是，N20-P25波幅增高在两种表型中均出现，提示感觉皮层过度兴奋可能是MND的普遍特征，而非单纯的运动系统问题。SEP异常与运动诱发电位异常无显著关联，表明感觉通路异常独立于皮质脊髓束功能障碍。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS/MND不仅是运动系统疾病、而是涉及感觉皮层回路的多系统网络疾病提供了大型队列证据，提示体感诱发电位可能成为评估疾病谱系中皮层过度兴奋状态的有用工具，值得ALS研究者关注其在疾病机制和诊断分型中的潜在价值。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在系统调查运动神经元病（MND）患者队列中体感诱发电位（SEP）的异常情况，并探讨其与运动诱发电位（MEP）及临床表型的关系。研究者回顾性分析了267例确诊MND并接受标准化SEP和经颅磁刺激检查的患者。患者被分为纯/主要上运动神经元（UMN）组和纯/主要下运动神经元/肌萎缩侧索硬化（LMN/ALS）组。SEP异常依据内部规范数据进行评估，包括潜伏期延长、波幅降低及N20-P25波幅增高。MEP由独立评估者半定量分类为正常或异常。结果显示，75%的患者至少存在一项SEP异常，UMN组与LMN/ALS组之间无显著差异。两种表型均观察到N20-P25波幅增高，提示MND谱系中存在广泛的躯体感觉皮层过度兴奋。相比之下，异常MEP在UMN患者中显著更常见（p < 0.001）。SEP异常与MEP结果之间未发现显著关联。上下肢SEP潜伏期强相关（均p < 0.001），而SEP波幅增高与潜伏期异常无相关性。SEP异常在MND中高度普遍，且在很大程度上独立于皮质脊髓功能障碍。SEP波幅增高可能反映原发性皮层感觉过度兴奋，而非感觉传导受损。这些发现支持MND是一种涉及感觉皮层回路的多系统网络疾病的概念，并强调SEP在诊断评估中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的大型队列数据，揭示了MND中感觉皮层过度兴奋独立于运动通路功能障碍，为ALS作为多系统网络疾病的概念提供了新近的神经生理学证据。

items.title: Repairing the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trial Credibility Gap.
items.summary: There is a long history of early- and mid-phase amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trial data being used to make claims of clinical benefit that fail to translate into successful phase 3 outcomes. It is suggested that fallacious scientific reasoning is being encouraged by perverse incentives arising from a "clinical trial industrial complex" that greatly influences trial design, data interpretation, and results communication. Recurring fallacies include false premises underlying outcome comparisons, misuse and incorrect interpretation of biomarkers, mismatches between study design and stated objectives, selective reporting of outcomes, over-reliance on post hoc analyses and open-label extension data, and overly optimistic framing of inconclusive data. We argue that these practices, reinforced by misaligned incentives across industry and academia, lead to premature claims of therapeutic promise and tangible harm to patients. To address the resulting ALS clinical trial credibility gap, we call for rigorous adherence to established standards for reporting clinical trial results, clearer distinction between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing, more measured description of trial results, and more disciplined triage of phase 2 programs. A cultural shift toward scientific skepticism and methodological rigor is essential to accelerate the development of genuinely effective ALS therapies.
items.titleZh: 修复肌萎缩侧索硬化临床试验的可信度缺口
items.summaryZh: 这篇观点文章指出，ALS早期临床试验中普遍存在夸大疗效宣称的问题，导致许多药物在3期试验中失败。作者认为，错误的激励体系（“临床试验工业复合体”）助长了不严谨的科学推理，包括滥用生物标志物、选择性报告结果和过度解读事后分析。他们呼吁提高报告标准、区分假设生成与验证，并加强2期项目的筛选，以恢复ALS试验的可信度。
items.insight: 这篇评论直接挑战了ALS领域长期存在的“阳性结果”文化，提醒研究者警惕早期数据的过度解读，并强调方法学严谨性对加速有效疗法开发的重要性。对于跟踪ALS药物研发的科研人员，它提供了批判性评估试验结果的框架，有助于避免重复过去的失败模式。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS早期试验中普遍存在夸大疗效宣称，源于激励错位和方法学缺陷，需通过文化变革和严格标准修复。
aiRead.limitation: 作为观点文章，缺乏实证数据支持，且未提供具体解决方案的实施细节。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否出现针对ALS试验报告标准的具体指南或政策变化，以及2期试验筛选新框架的提出。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）早期和中期的临床试验数据长期被用来宣称临床获益，但这些宣称往往未能在成功的3期试验中转化。本文认为，由“临床试验工业复合体”产生的反常激励助长了错误的科学推理，该复合体极大地影响了试验设计、数据解读和结果传播。反复出现的谬误包括：结果比较所依据的错误前提、生物标志物的误用和错误解读、研究设计与既定目标不匹配、结果的选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签扩展数据，以及对不确定数据的过度乐观表述。我们认为，这些做法在产业界和学术界错位激励的强化下，导致过早宣称治疗前景，并对患者造成切实伤害。为解决由此产生的ALS临床试验可信度缺口，我们呼吁严格遵守既定的临床试验结果报告标准，明确区分假设生成与假设检验，更审慎地描述试验结果，并对2期项目进行更严格的筛选。转向科学怀疑主义和方法学严谨性的文化变革对于加速开发真正有效的ALS疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该文发表于2026年，针对ALS临床试验中持续存在的可信度危机提出系统性改革建议，直接关联ALS药物开发的转化价值。

items.title: ATXN2 Spectrum Disorders: Genetic Complexity Beyond Dominant Inheritance.
items.summary: The genetic complexity of ATXN2 challenges conventional paradigms in neurodegeneration. While initially linked to autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 2, ATXN2 CAG expansions have emerged as a major risk factor for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In a recent article, Saucier et al. describe an Acadian family with a recessive inheritance pattern of ATXN2 -related disease, challenging the long-held assumption of a predominantly autosomal dominant, gain-of-function-driven mechanism. Here, we analyze how ATXN2 's inheritance mode may shift based on repeat interruptions, somatic mosaicism, and gene dosage, suggesting that loss-of-function mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis in certain contexts. We discuss implications for disease classification, genetic counseling, and therapeutic strategies, emphasizing the need for genetic stratification.
items.titleZh: ATXN2 谱系疾病：超越显性遗传的遗传复杂性
items.summaryZh: 本文评论了 ATXN2 基因相关疾病遗传模式的复杂性。传统观点认为 ATXN2 相关疾病主要由常染色体显性遗传的功能获得性机制驱动，但新发现的隐性遗传家系提示，功能缺失机制也可能参与发病。重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量等因素可能影响遗传模式。这对 ALS 研究的意义在于，ATXN2 中间长度 CAG 重复是 ALS 的重要风险因素，理解其遗传复杂性有助于更精准的遗传分层和未来的治疗策略开发。
items.insight: 该评论文章直接挑战了 ATXN2 相关疾病仅由显性功能获得性机制驱动的传统观点，提出隐性遗传和功能缺失机制也可能参与其中。对于 ALS 研究者而言，这提示 ATXN2 相关 ALS 的遗传背景可能比预期的更复杂，理解重复序列中断和体细胞嵌合等修饰因素，对于解释携带者表型异质性、优化遗传咨询以及设计针对特定遗传亚型的治疗策略至关重要。

aiRead.keyFinding: ATXN2 相关疾病可能不仅限于常染色体显性功能获得性机制，在特定情况下（如重复中断、体细胞嵌合、基因剂量效应）可能表现为隐性遗传或功能缺失机制参与发病。
aiRead.limitation: 作为评论文章，其观点基于对已发表家系研究的分析，缺乏直接的实验数据验证；所提出的功能缺失机制仍需更多功能学研究证实。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注 Saucier 等人原始家系研究的全文数据，以及后续针对 ATXN2 功能缺失机制的细胞或动物模型研究；同时留意 ATXN2 重复中断模式在散发性 ALS 队列中的频率分析。

items.abstractZh: ATXN2 的遗传复杂性对神经退行性疾病的传统范式提出了挑战。虽然最初与常染色体显性遗传的脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型相关，但 ATXN2 CAG 扩增已成为肌萎缩侧索硬化的重要风险因素。在最近的一篇文章中，Saucier 等人描述了一个具有 ATXN2 相关疾病隐性遗传模式的阿卡迪亚家族，这对长期以来的主要常染色体显性、功能获得性驱动机制的假设提出了挑战。在此，我们分析了 ATXN2 的遗传模式如何可能根据重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量而改变，表明功能缺失机制在某些情况下有助于发病机制。我们讨论了对疾病分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略的影响，并强调遗传分层的必要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该评论基于 2026 年最新发表的隐性遗传家系研究，重新审视 ALS 风险基因 ATXN2 的遗传范式，具有直接的 ALS 相关性。

items.title: Circular RNAs in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the progressive loss of motor neurons, with most cases lacking a clear genetic basis. Emerging evidence highlights the involvement of non-coding RNAs, particularly circular RNAs (circRNAs), in disease onset and progression. Here, we investigated circRNAs implicated in ALS and related motor neuron diseases (MNDs). Here, we provide a general overview of circular RNA metabolism and cellular functions. We then present our systematic literature review that identified ALS-associated circRNAs, followed by in silico analyses of 15 circular RNA candidates that were selected based on the most compelling data regarding ALS. Our results revealed that several circular RNAs regulate ALS-related genes, such as unfolded protein response, oxidative stress, cell cycle regulation, and apoptosis. Protein-RNA interaction analysis further showed that ALS-related circRNAs can sponge 20 RNA-binding proteins. Additionally, molecular docking analysis demonstrated that ALS-associated FUS variants significantly alter its binding affinity to circular RNAs. RNA-seq data from ALS patients confirmed significant alterations in the expression of host genes of ALS-related circRNAs and hub proteins in ALS-affected CNS tissues. Collectively, our findings identify circRNAs as potential key contributors to ALS pathogenesis.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中的环状RNA
items.summaryZh: 这项研究通过系统性文献回顾和计算机模拟分析，筛选出15个与ALS相关的环状RNA（circRNA）候选分子。研究发现这些circRNA参与调控ALS相关基因，涉及未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期和凋亡等通路，并能海绵吸附20个RNA结合蛋白。此外，ALS相关的FUS基因变异会改变其与circRNA的结合能力，患者组织RNA-seq数据也证实了相关基因表达的改变。研究提示circRNA可能是ALS病理机制中的重要参与者。
items.insight: 该研究为circRNA在ALS发病机制中的作用提供了系统性证据，特别是揭示了circRNA与FUS蛋白变异之间的相互作用，为理解非遗传性ALS的分子基础以及开发基于circRNA的生物标志物或治疗靶点提供了新方向。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，其特征是运动神经元的进行性丧失，大多数病例缺乏明确的遗传基础。新出现的证据强调了非编码RNA，特别是环状RNA（circRNAs），在疾病发生和进展中的作用。在此，我们研究了与ALS及相关运动神经元疾病（MNDs）有关的circRNAs。我们首先概述了环状RNA的代谢和细胞功能，随后进行了系统性文献回顾以识别与ALS相关的circRNAs，并基于最有力的数据对15个circRNA候选分子进行了计算机模拟分析。结果显示，多个环状RNA调控ALS相关基因，涉及未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期调控和凋亡等通路。蛋白质-RNA相互作用分析进一步表明，ALS相关circRNAs可海绵吸附20个RNA结合蛋白。此外，分子对接分析显示，ALS相关的FUS变异显著改变其与circRNAs的结合亲和力。来自ALS患者的RNA-seq数据证实，在ALS受累的中枢神经系统中，ALS相关circRNAs的宿主基因及核心蛋白的表达发生显著改变。综上，我们的研究结果表明circRNAs是ALS发病机制的潜在关键贡献者。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，结合系统文献回顾与多维度计算机模拟分析，揭示了circRNA在ALS中调控多个疾病相关通路并与FUS变异直接互作，具有明确的ALS转化研究价值。

items.title: Nuclear SOD1 links ATM-CHK2 signaling to ADH5/GSNOR transcription in SHSY-5Y SOD1 G93A cellular models of ALS.
items.summary: The activity of S-nitrosoglutathione reductase (ADH5/GSNOR) has been proposed being essential to limit oxidative stress and preserve mitochondrial quality control. Here we identify a redox-dependent ATM-CHK2-SOD1 signaling axis that drives ADH5/GSNOR transcription in SH-SY5Y cells expressing the ALS-associated SOD1 G93A mutant. ATM-CHK2 activation promotes the interaction of SOD1 with CHK2, leading to SOD1 nuclear translocation and binding to the ADH5 promoter. Pharmacological inhibition of ATM or CHK2 abolishes these effects. ADH5/GSNOR overexpression protects cells from SOD1 G93A -induced toxicity suggesting that the modulation of GSNOR activity may represent a potential strategy to restore redox homeostasis in ALS.
items.titleZh: 核SOD1将ATM-CHK2信号与ALS SHSY-5Y SOD1 G93A细胞模型中的ADH5/GSNOR转录联系起来
items.summaryZh: 这项细胞研究发现了一条新的信号通路：在表达ALS相关SOD1 G93A突变的细胞中，ATM-CHK2信号激活后，SOD1进入细胞核并结合ADH5基因启动子，促进ADH5/GSNOR（一种抗氧化酶）的转录。抑制ATM或CHK2会阻断这一过程。过表达ADH5/GSNOR能减轻SOD1 G93A突变带来的细胞毒性，提示增强GSNOR活性可能有助于对抗ALS中的氧化应激。
items.insight: 该研究首次将DNA损伤应答激酶ATM-CHK2与SOD1的核功能及抗氧化基因ADH5/GSNOR的转录调控联系起来，为SOD1相关ALS的毒性机制提供了新的分子解释，并提示GSNOR可能成为新的治疗靶点。

aiRead.limitation: 研究仅在单一细胞系（SH-SY5Y）中进行，缺乏体内动物模型验证；且未直接评估GSNOR活性变化对ALS病程的影响。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否在SOD1 G93A转基因小鼠或患者来源的iPSC神经元中验证该信号轴，以及ATM/CHK2抑制剂或GSNOR增强剂在体内模型中的疗效。

items.abstractZh: S-亚硝基谷胱甘肽还原酶（ADH5/GSNOR）的活性被认为对于限制氧化应激和维持线粒体质量控制至关重要。本研究在表达ALS相关SOD1 G93A突变体的SH-SY5Y细胞中，鉴定出一条氧化还原依赖的ATM-CHK2-SOD1信号轴，该信号轴驱动ADH5/GSNOR转录。ATM-CHK2激活促进SOD1与CHK2的相互作用，导致SOD1核转位并结合至ADH5启动子。药理学抑制ATM或CHK2可消除这些效应。ADH5/GSNOR过表达可保护细胞免受SOD1 G93A诱导的毒性，提示调节GSNOR活性可能代表一种恢复ALS中氧化还原稳态的潜在策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，揭示了SOD1 G93A突变通过ATM-CHK2信号轴调控抗氧化基因转录的新机制，为ALS的氧化应激病理提供了具有转化潜力的新靶点。

items.title: Familial, neuropathological and cellular analysis identify ARPP21 as a major amyotrophic lateral sclerosis associated gene in French cohorts.
items.summary: ARPP21 has recently emerged as a new amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) associated gene but its pathogenic role remains unclear. In this study we performed familial, clinical, neuropathological and cellular analyses to characterize the recurrent p.P529L and p.P713L variants (also known as p.P563L variant and p.P747L variant, respectively) in our French ALS cohort of 1190 ALS cases and 50 additional family members available for segregation analysis, resulting in the description of 29 ARPP21-linked patients. ARPP21 emerged as the most frequent rare ALS-associated gene in France after exclusion of the four major ALS genes, accounting for 2.7% of familial cases (fALS) and 0.1% of sporadic cases. Age-dependent penetrance reached 45% by age 50 and increased only modestly thereafter, remaining incomplete even at advanced ages. In cellular models, the p.P713L mutant showed aggregation associated with protein hyperphosphorylation and colocalization with the autophagic marker p62. Neuropathological examination of tissue from a p.P529L carrier revealed typical cytoplasmic TDP-43 pathology, together with heterogeneous ARPP21-positive deposits. As ARPP21 antibody also stained granulovacuolar degenerations, ARPP21-positive deposits may reflect neuronal stress rather than mutant ARPP21-specific pathology. Nevertheless, together with previous studies, our findings support ARPP21 as an important ALS-associated gene, and indicate that both p.P529L/p.P563L and p.P713L/p.P747L should be considered pathogenic ALS-causing variants. Incorporating ARPP21 into the routine genetic testing panels for fALS could improve diagnostic yield.

items.title: Role of complement and complement-targeted therapeutics in neurological diseases.
items.summary: Complement comprises a group of plasma and membrane proteins that provide an effective bridging function for innate and adaptive humoral immunity. Understanding complement pathophysiology is fundamental given that inappropriate complement function in host defence can lead to infectious diseases and inefficient disposal of altered, damaged or senescent cells can lead to or enhance autoimmune neurological processes. Although the rising number of approved drugs targeting complement pathways remains primarily focused on diseases with complement-fixing pathogenic antibodies (such as myasthenia gravis and neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder), a robust pipeline of emerging treatments holds promise for expanding complement-targeted therapies to a broader spectrum of autoimmune neurological diseases, such as multiple sclerosis and even neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer disease or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. This Review presents insights into complement biology as it relates to the development or initiation of autoimmune and possibly degenerative diseases affecting the central and peripheral nervous systems or muscle. The effects, merits, risks and challenges of marketed drugs or biologic agents in ongoing phase I-III clinical trials engineered to inhibit proximal or distal components of the complement cascade are also discussed. Anti-complement therapeutics are destined to change the treatment of autoimmune neurologic conditions in which the therapeutic landscape is now becoming crowded with biologic agents targeting other key autoimmunity factors.

items.abstractZh: 补体由一组血浆蛋白和膜蛋白组成，为先天性和适应性体液免疫提供有效的桥接功能。理解补体病理生理学至关重要，因为补体在宿主防御中的不当功能可导致感染性疾病，而对改变、受损或衰老细胞的不有效清除可导致或增强自身免疫性神经过程。尽管获批的靶向补体通路的药物数量不断增加，但仍主要集中于具有补体固定致病抗体的疾病（如重症肌无力和视神经脊髓炎谱系疾病），但新兴治疗药物的强大管线有望将补体靶向治疗扩展到更广泛的自身免疫性神经系统疾病，如多发性硬化，甚至神经退行性疾病，如阿尔茨海默病或肌萎缩侧索硬化。本综述提供了关于补体生物学与影响中枢及外周神经系统或肌肉的自身免疫性和可能的退行性疾病发展或启动相关的见解。还讨论了已上市药物或正在进行I-III期临床试验的生物制剂在抑制补体级联近端或远端成分方面的效果、优点、风险和挑战。抗补体治疗注定将改变自身免疫性神经系统疾病的治疗，在该领域，针对其他关键自身免疫因子的生物制剂已使治疗格局日益拥挤。

items.title: Recurrent patterns of TOP1-mediated neuronal genomic damage shared by major neurodegenerative disorders.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal dementia (FTD), and Alzheimer's disease (AD) represent two major categories of neurodegenerative disorders-TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) and tau proteinopathies-for which the mechanisms driving neuronal death remain unclear. Single-cell whole-genome sequencing of 469 neurons from C9ORF72 ALS, C9ORF72 FTD, AD, and control brains revealed increased somatic single-nucleotide variants (sSNVs) and insertions/deletions (sIndels) in all three diseases. Mutational signature analysis identified a disease-associated sSNV signature consistent with oxidative damage and an sIndel process affecting 22% of ALS, 76% of FTD, and 61% of AD neurons-but only 2% of control neurons-resembling signature ID4, previously linked to topoisomerase 1 (TOP1)-mediated mutagenesis. Rapid approach to DNA adduct recovery (RADAR) assays confirmed increased TOP1-DNA covalent complexes, and duplex sequencing confirmed the increased sIndels and identified single-strand events as likely precursor lesions. TOP1-associated sIndel mutagenesis and genome instability thus represent a mechanism shared by both TDP-43 and tau neurodegeneration.

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）、额颞叶痴呆（FTD）和阿尔茨海默病（AD）代表了两大类神经退行性疾病——TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）蛋白病和tau蛋白病——其驱动神经元死亡的机制仍不清楚。对来自C9ORF72 ALS、C9ORF72 FTD、AD和对照脑的469个神经元进行单细胞全基因组测序，发现所有三种疾病中体细胞单核苷酸变异（sSNVs）和插入/缺失（sIndels）均增加。突变特征分析鉴定出一种与氧化损伤相关的疾病相关sSNV特征，以及一种影响22% ALS、76% FTD和61% AD神经元（但仅2%对照神经元）的sIndel过程，该过程类似于先前与拓扑异构酶1（TOP1）介导的突变发生相关的特征ID4。快速DNA加合物恢复（RADAR）分析证实了TOP1-DNA共价复合物的增加，双链测序证实了sIndels的增加，并鉴定出单链事件可能是前体病变。因此，TOP1相关的sIndel突变发生和基因组不稳定性代表了TDP-43和tau神经退行性变共有的机制。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，利用单细胞测序技术揭示了ALS、FTD和AD共有的TOP1介导基因组损伤机制，具有高度的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Cumulative environmental burden and neurodegenerative disease mortality: a national ecological study in the United States.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs) represent a growing cause of mortality and disability among aging populations worldwide. However, the relationship between cumulative, multidomain environmental exposures, and NDD mortality remains poorly characterized. This study aimed to examine the association between comprehensive environmental quality and NDD mortality in the United States. We used the environmental quality index (EQI) from 2000 to 2005 to characterize cumulative environmental exposure. Associations between EQI quintiles and NDD mortality, including dementia, Parkinson's disease (PD), amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and Huntington's disease, were examined using Bayesian interval-censored mixed-effects models. During 2006-2020, among 3.66 million NDD deaths, poorer environmental quality (Q5 vs Q1) was associated with mortality rate differences of 24.72 (95% credible intervals [CrI]: 22.43, 27.06) per 100 000 at 5-year lag, 26.74 (95% CrI: 24.34, 29.21) at 10-year lag, and 22.74 (95% CrI: 20.49, 25.13) at 15-year lag. Within each lag period, a clear dose-response pattern was consistently observed across EQI quintiles. Furthermore, associations were most pronounced for the air quality, followed by sociodemographic disadvantage. In addition, demographic and geographic heterogeneity was observed across sex, race, census regions, urbanicity, climate zone, and county economic type. These findings underscore the need for integrated, place-based environmental health policies targeting neurodegeneration prevention.

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDDs）是全球老龄化人口中死亡和残疾的一个日益增长的原因。然而，累积的、多领域的环境暴露与NDD死亡率之间的关系仍缺乏充分描述。本研究旨在考察美国综合环境质量与NDD死亡率之间的关联。我们使用2000-2005年的环境质量指数（EQI）来表征累积环境暴露。采用贝叶斯区间删失混合效应模型，检验EQI五分位数与NDD死亡率（包括痴呆、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症和亨廷顿病）之间的关联。在2006-2020年期间，在366万例NDD死亡中，较差的环境质量（Q5 vs Q1）与死亡率差异相关：5年滞后时为每10万人24.72（95%可信区间[CrI]：22.43, 27.06），10年滞后时为26.74（95% CrI：24.34, 29.21），15年滞后时为22.74（95% CrI：20.49, 25.13）。在每个滞后期内，EQI五分位数之间均一致观察到明显的剂量-反应模式。此外，空气质量的关联最为显著，其次是社会人口劣势。另外，在性别、种族、人口普查区域、城乡、气候带和县级经济类型方面观察到人口和地理异质性。这些发现强调了制定综合的、基于地方的环境健康政策以针对神经退行性疾病的预防。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2000-2005年环境数据与2006-2020年死亡率数据，具有新近性，且直接关联环境负担与ALS等神经退行性疾病死亡率，具有转化价值。

items.title: Mechanistic Characterization of NABi as a Selective Inhibitor of SOD1G93A Aggregation: Structural Basis and Therapeutic Implications for ALS.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a devastating neurodegenerative disease characterized by the progressive loss of motor neurons, with familial ALS (fALS) frequently caused by mutations in Cu/Zn superoxide dismutase (SOD1). The G93A mutation, one of the most aggressive forms, promotes the formation of cytotoxic protein aggregates through cross-β-sheet structures, leading to neuronal dysfunction and death. In this study, we investigated the therapeutic potential of NABi (natural Aβ binder and Aβ-aggregation inhibitor), a stable small engineered protein composed of the N-terminal 90 amino acids of SOD1, originally developed to target amyloid-β aggregation in Alzheimer's disease. Given the shared β-sheet-rich aggregation mechanisms between amyloid-β and mutant SOD1 proteins, we hypothesized that NABi could serve as a dual-action therapeutic for both diseases. Through an integrated approach involving structural, biochemical, and cellular analyses, we demonstrate that NABi exhibits a 4-fold greater binding affinity for SOD1G93A compared to SOD1WT, selectively targeting the mutant protein via specific hydrophobic interactions. Structural modeling using AlphaFold2 reveals that the G93A mutation exposes hydrophobic residues that create an optimal binding interface for NABi. Functionally, NABi effectively inhibits SOD1G93A aggregation, as demonstrated by filter trap assays and immunofluorescence microscopy, while maintaining the protein in a soluble, nontoxic state. Importantly, coexpression of NABi reduces SOD1G93A-induced cytotoxicity by approximately 4-fold, significantly enhancing neuronal survival. These findings establish NABi as a promising therapeutic candidate for SOD1G93A-associated familial ALS, demonstrating its capacity to selectively target pathological protein conformations while preserving normal cellular function. Our results support the development of NABi as an innovative pan-therapeutic approach targeting shared aggregation pathways across multiple neurodegenerative diseases.
items.titleZh: NABi作为SOD1G93A聚集选择性抑制剂的机制表征：ALS的结构基础与治疗意义
items.summaryZh: 这项研究测试了一种名为NABi的小型工程蛋白，它原本针对阿尔茨海默病中的淀粉样蛋白聚集，但研究者发现它也能选择性结合并抑制ALS相关突变蛋白SOD1G93A的聚集。实验显示，NABi对突变蛋白的亲和力是正常蛋白的4倍，并能将突变蛋白引起的细胞毒性降低约4倍，从而保护神经元。这提示NABi可能成为治疗SOD1突变相关家族性ALS的潜在候选药物。
items.insight: 这项研究值得ALS研究者关注，因为它提出了一种跨疾病共享聚集机制的泛治疗策略，并利用结构建模揭示了突变特异性结合的基础，为开发针对SOD1突变的选择性抑制剂提供了新思路。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种毁灭性的神经退行性疾病，其特征是运动神经元的进行性丧失，家族性ALS（fALS）常由Cu/Zn超氧化物歧化酶（SOD1）突变引起。G93A突变是最具侵袭性的形式之一，通过交叉β-折叠结构促进细胞毒性蛋白聚集体的形成，导致神经元功能障碍和死亡。本研究探讨了NABi（天然Aβ结合剂和Aβ聚集抑制剂）的治疗潜力，NABi是一种由SOD1 N端90个氨基酸组成的稳定小工程蛋白，最初开发用于靶向阿尔茨海默病中的淀粉样β聚集。鉴于淀粉样β和突变SOD1蛋白之间共享富含β-折叠的聚集机制，我们假设NABi可作为这两种疾病的双重作用治疗药物。通过结构、生化和细胞分析的综合方法，我们证明NABi对SOD1G93A的结合亲和力比SOD1WT高4倍，通过特异性疏水相互作用选择性靶向突变蛋白。使用AlphaFold2的结构建模揭示，G93A突变暴露了疏水残基，为NABi创造了最佳结合界面。功能上，NABi有效抑制SOD1G93A聚集，如过滤陷阱实验和免疫荧光显微镜所示，同时保持蛋白质处于可溶性、无毒状态。重要的是，NABi的共表达将SOD1G93A诱导的细胞毒性降低约4倍，显著增强神经元存活。这些发现确立了NABi作为SOD1G93A相关家族性ALS的有前景治疗候选药物，展示了其选择性靶向病理蛋白构象同时保留正常细胞功能的能力。我们的结果支持将NABi开发为一种创新的泛治疗策略，针对多种神经退行性疾病中共享的聚集途径。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年最新发表的实验数据，利用AlphaFold2结构建模和生化实验，首次证明NABi能选择性靶向SOD1G93A突变蛋白，具有转化为ALS治疗的潜力。

items.title: Implementation of specialised care improves survival in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Access to multidisciplinary care influences survival in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (pwALS). However, real-world data comparing structured specialised care with general neurological management remain limited. We aimed to assess the influence of implementing a specialised outpatient clinic on survival in pwALS. This retrospective cohort study included pwALS meeting the Gold Coast criteria who were treated at the Department of Neurology of the Medical University of Vienna between January 2009 and July 2023. Demographic and clinical parameters and survival data were obtained from the local ALS registry, the Austrian Federation of Social Insurance databases, and the national mortality database of Statistik Austria. Data were censored in December 2024. Outcomes were compared between patients managed before (general care cohort) and after the establishment of a specialised ALS outpatient clinic in 2018 (specialised care cohort). A total of 242 pwALS were included (47.5% female), of whom 43.8% received general neurological care and 56.2% specialised care. Spinal onset ALS was observed in 65.1% and 70.6%, respectively. Baseline demographic and clinical characteristics were comparable between both cohorts. Median survival time was 27.0 months (95% CI 23.0-35.0) in the general care cohort and 40.0 months (95% CI 32.0-47.0) in specialised care cohort (p = 0.0173). This survival difference was driven by patients with spinal onset ALS, whereas no benefit was observed in those with bulbar onset disease. Specialised care was associated with improved survival in this real-world ALS cohort, likely reflecting the cumulative effect of coordinated multidisciplinary management rather than individual interventions.

items.titleZh: 专业化护理的实施可改善肌萎缩侧索硬化症患者的生存率
items.summaryZh: 这项来自维也纳的单中心回顾性研究比较了专业ALS门诊建立前后患者的生存情况。结果显示，接受专业多学科护理的ALS患者中位生存期比接受普通神经科管理的患者长约13个月（40个月 vs 27个月），差异具有统计学意义。生存获益主要体现在脊髓起病患者中，延髓起病患者未见明显获益。研究提示，结构化的多学科协作管理模式可能比单一治疗手段更能改善ALS患者的长期预后。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS临床管理提供了重要的真实世界证据，表明专业多学科护理模式本身就能显著延长患者生存期。对于ALS研究者而言，这一发现强调了在临床试验设计和真实世界治疗中，护理模式的标准化和结构化可能成为影响结局的关键变量，也提示未来需要探索多学科管理中哪些具体环节（如呼吸支持、营养管理、康复介入等）贡献最大。

aiRead.keyFinding: 专业多学科护理与ALS患者中位生存期显著延长相关（40 vs 27个月，p=0.0173），获益主要见于脊髓起病患者。
aiRead.limitation: 回顾性设计可能存在选择偏倚；单中心数据外推性有限；未详细分析多学科管理中具体干预措施的贡献；延髓起病亚组样本量可能不足以检测差异。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否有多中心前瞻性研究验证该结论，以及探索专业护理中具体干预组合（如呼吸、营养、康复）对生存获益的独立贡献。

items.abstractZh: 获得多学科护理会影响肌萎缩侧索硬化症（pwALS）患者的生存率。然而，比较结构化专业护理与普通神经科管理的真实世界数据仍然有限。我们旨在评估实施专业门诊对pwALS患者生存率的影响。这项回顾性队列研究纳入了符合Gold Coast标准、于2009年1月至2023年7月在维也纳医科大学神经内科接受治疗的pwALS患者。人口统计学和临床参数及生存数据来自当地ALS登记处、奥地利社会保险联合会数据库和奥地利统计局国家死亡率数据库。数据在2024年12月进行审查。比较了2018年专业ALS门诊建立前（普通护理队列）和建立后（专业护理队列）管理患者的结局。共纳入242名pwALS患者（47.5%为女性），其中43.8%接受普通神经科护理，56.2%接受专业护理。脊髓起病ALS在两组中分别占65.1%和70.6%。两个队列的基线人口统计学和临床特征具有可比性。普通护理队列的中位生存时间为27.0个月（95% CI 23.0-35.0），专业护理队列为40.0个月（95% CI 32.0-47.0）（p = 0.0173）。这一生存差异主要由脊髓起病的ALS患者驱动，而延髓起病患者未观察到获益。在该真实世界ALS队列中，专业护理与生存率提高相关，这可能反映了协调的多学科管理的累积效应，而非单一干预措施的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2024年12月的最新随访数据，直接验证了ALS专业护理模式的转化价值，为优化临床管理策略提供了新近的真实世界依据。

items.title: Establishment of a novel human nervous system tissue bank: University of Debrecen tissue bank-introduction and retrospective data analysis.
items.summary: Human brain tissues obtained from autopsies, as well as muscle and nerve samples derived from biopsies, constitute indispensable resources for translational research investigating the pathomechanisms of neuropsychiatric disorders. In this study, we introduce the Nervous System Tissue Bank of University of Debrecen, which contains formalin-preserved and formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) brain samples, as well as frozen nerve and muscle biopsy specimens. Database was established containing clinical and pathological parameters. For autopsy cases, the following variables were recorded: sex, age, number of hospitalization days, admission diagnosis, comorbidities, cause of death, post-mortem interval, general autopsy findings, and macro- and microscopic brain pathology diagnoses. For biopsy samples, we recorded: sex, age, biopsy site, and microscopic and molecular genetic diagnoses. Based on the recorded parameters and their temporal changes, retrospective statistical analyses were performed. Formalin-fixed brain samples and FFPE blocks were available from 2425 deceased individuals, and nerve/muscle samples from 257 patients. The brain samples originate from the period between 1990 and 2012. The most frequent admission diagnoses included ischemic stroke (n = 1070), hemorrhagic stroke (n = 462), subarachnoid hemorrhage (n = 102), epilepsy (n = 103), brain metastasis (n = 70), primary brain tumor (n = 60), parkinsonism (n = 28), dementia (n = 21), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (n = 21). Prevalence of hypertension (67.6%) and diabetes mellitus (20.1%) showed a significant increase over time (p < 0.001), whereas the prevalence of malignancies, dementia, parkinsonism, and psychiatric disorders remained stable. Our tissue bank represents the largest nervous system collection in Hungary, providing well-characterized brain, muscle, and nerve samples linked to nearly three decades of clinical data. Samples are made available to researchers.
items.titleZh: 新型人类神经系统组织库的建立：德布勒森大学组织库介绍及回顾性数据分析
items.summaryZh: 匈牙利德布勒森大学建立了一个大型神经系统组织库，包含来自2425名逝者的脑组织样本和257名患者的神经/肌肉活检样本，时间跨度近三十年。该库详细记录了临床和病理信息，其中包含21例ALS病例。高血压和糖尿病患病率随时间显著上升。该资源为ALS等神经退行性疾病的病理机制研究提供了宝贵的样本和数据基础。
items.insight: 对于ALS研究者而言，该组织库的价值在于其提供了与近三十年纵向临床数据相关联的、特征明确的脑、肌肉和神经组织样本。尽管ALS病例数（21例）相对有限，但结合详细的临床病程和合并症数据，这些样本可用于验证生物标志物、研究疾病异质性以及探索ALS与其他神经精神疾病的共病机制，是转化研究的重要资源。

items.abstractZh: 来自尸检的人脑组织以及来自活检的肌肉和神经样本，是研究神经精神疾病病理机制的转化研究中不可或缺的资源。本研究介绍了德布勒森大学神经系统组织库，该库包含福尔马林保存和福尔马林固定石蜡包埋（FFPE）的脑样本，以及冷冻的神经和肌肉活检标本。研究建立了包含临床和病理参数的数据库。对于尸检病例，记录了以下变量：性别、年龄、住院天数、入院诊断、合并症、死亡原因、尸检间隔时间、一般尸检结果以及宏观和微观脑病理诊断。对于活检样本，记录了：性别、年龄、活检部位以及微观和分子遗传学诊断。基于记录的参数及其随时间的变化，进行了回顾性统计分析。可获得来自2425名 deceased 个体的福尔马林固定脑样本和FFPE块，以及来自257名患者的神经/肌肉样本。脑样本来源于1990年至2012年期间。最常见的入院诊断包括缺血性卒中（n=1070）、出血性卒中（n=462）、蛛网膜下腔出血（n=102）、癫痫（n=103）、脑转移瘤（n=70）、原发性脑肿瘤（n=60）、帕金森综合征（n=28）、痴呆（n=21）和肌萎缩侧索硬化症（n=21）。高血压（67.6%）和糖尿病（20.1%）的患病率随时间显著增加（p < 0.001），而恶性肿瘤、痴呆、帕金森综合征和精神疾病的患病率保持稳定。我们的组织库代表了匈牙利最大的神经系统样本收藏，提供了与近三十年临床数据相关联的、特征明确的脑、肌肉和神经样本。样本可供研究人员使用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究通过建立包含近三十年临床数据的大型生物样本库，为ALS等神经退行性疾病的转化研究提供了新近的、可获取的关键资源平台。

items.title: C9orf72-associated poly-GR in skeletal muscle leads to neuromuscular junction deficits and muscle atrophy.
items.summary: Hexanucleotide repeat expansions in C9orf72 produce dipeptide repeat (DPR) proteins that are widely expressed, including in the nervous system and skeletal muscle. Among these DPRs, arginine-containing proteins, poly-GR and poly-PR, are toxic in the nervous system, but whether DPRs in skeletal muscle contribute to amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) pathogenesis is unclear. Here, we show that muscle-restricted expression of poly-GR drives motor deficits in mice, including muscle atrophy and neuromuscular junction (NMJ) deficits. Poly-GR in muscle interacted with the NMJ key organizer MuSK and promoted MuSK degradation, disrupting postsynaptic structure and impairing neuromuscular transmission. Importantly, a MuSK agonist antibody (X-17) stabilized NMJs and rescued neuromuscular transmission. Moreover, poly-GR in muscle activated the integrated stress response (ISR), elevating eIF2α phosphorylation and broadly suppressing protein translation. ISR inhibition with ISRIB restored translation and MuSK protein levels and ameliorated both muscle atrophy and NMJ deficits. These findings demonstrate that skeletal muscle actively contributes to C9orf72-ALS pathology. Targeting muscle with ISRIB offers a therapeutic strategy to preserve motor function in C9orf72-ALS.
items.titleZh: C9orf72相关poly-GR在骨骼肌中导致神经肌肉接头缺陷和肌肉萎缩
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，在C9orf72相关ALS中，骨骼肌中表达的poly-GR蛋白不仅导致肌肉萎缩，还通过降解MuSK蛋白破坏神经肌肉接头，并激活整合应激反应抑制蛋白质合成。使用ISRIB抑制应激反应或使用MuSK激动剂抗体X-17，可改善小鼠的肌肉和神经肌肉接头缺陷。这表明骨骼肌本身是ALS病理的重要参与者，而靶向肌肉的ISRIB治疗可能有助于保护运动功能。
items.insight: 该研究首次证明骨骼肌中poly-GR的毒性作用独立于运动神经元，直接导致NMJ缺陷和肌肉萎缩，为C9orf72-ALS的病理机制提供了新视角，并提出了肌肉靶向治疗策略，值得ALS研究者关注。

aiRead.keyFinding: 骨骼肌中poly-GR通过降解MuSK和激活ISR导致NMJ缺陷和肌肉萎缩，ISRIB或MuSK抗体可改善这些缺陷。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于小鼠模型，人类C9orf72-ALS中骨骼肌DPR的作用仍需验证；ISRIB的长期安全性和有效性未评估。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注ISRIB或MuSK激动剂抗体在C9orf72-ALS患者中的临床试验进展，以及骨骼肌DPR在人类样本中的表达验证。

items.abstractZh: C9orf72中的六核苷酸重复扩增产生二肽重复蛋白（DPR），这些蛋白广泛表达，包括在神经系统和骨骼肌中。在这些DPR中，含精氨酸的蛋白poly-GR和poly-PR在神经系统中具有毒性，但骨骼肌中的DPR是否参与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的发病机制尚不清楚。在此，我们表明，肌肉特异性表达poly-GR可驱动小鼠的运动缺陷，包括肌肉萎缩和神经肌肉接头（NMJ）缺陷。肌肉中的poly-GR与NMJ关键组织者MuSK相互作用，并促进MuSK降解，破坏突触后结构并损害神经肌肉传递。重要的是，MuSK激动剂抗体（X-17）稳定了NMJ并挽救了神经肌肉传递。此外，肌肉中的poly-GR激活了整合应激反应（ISR），提高eIF2α磷酸化并广泛抑制蛋白质翻译。用ISRIB抑制ISR可恢复翻译和MuSK蛋白水平，并改善肌肉萎缩和NMJ缺陷。这些发现表明，骨骼肌积极参与C9orf72-ALS的病理过程。以ISRIB靶向肌肉为在C9orf72-ALS中保留运动功能提供了一种治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，揭示了C9orf72-ALS中骨骼肌自主病理的新机制，并提出了ISRIB作为潜在治疗策略，具有直接的ALS转化价值。

items.summaryZh: 本文聚焦骨桥蛋白（osteopontin）在衰老相关神经系统疾病中的双重或情境依赖性角色。骨桥蛋白是一种在炎症和组织修复中发挥重要作用的细胞外基质蛋白，近年来在ALS等神经退行性疾病中被发现与疾病进展相关。该综述或研究提示，骨桥蛋白的作用可能因疾病阶段、细胞类型或病理环境而异，而非单一的保护性或致病性因子。
items.insight: 骨桥蛋白在ALS中已被报道为小胶质细胞活化和疾病进展的标志物，但对其在不同疾病阶段和细胞环境中的具体功能仍缺乏统一认识。本文强调“情境依赖性”，提示ALS研究者需关注骨桥蛋白在疾病不同阶段和不同细胞类型中的差异化作用，这可能影响未来以骨桥蛋白为靶点的治疗策略设计。

items.title: ALSGate: An Efficient Gated Mixture-of-Experts Model for Reliable ALS Detection Using EMG Signals.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder affecting motor neurons, resulting in neuromuscular weakness and paralysis. Electromyography (EMG) is of vital importance for the detection of ALS. In this paper, a refined mixture of experts is proposed that automatically discriminates ALS patients from non-ALS cases using clinical EMG signals from the N2001 EMGLAB open-access dataset. The architecture consists of a 1D convolutional neural network, a temporal convolutional network and a spectrogram-based CNN to collectively learn localised temporal, long-range temporal and spectral features from EMG activity. A gating mechanism dynamically weights expert contributions and performs significantly better than equal-weight fusion. Training with focal loss and exponential moving average stabilisation addresses class imbalance and improves convergence. The proposed approach reached an AUROC of 0.9992, an F1-score of 0.9903 and a balanced accuracy of 0.9905, demonstrating strong discriminative performance and potential for real-time clinical applications.
